parameters.query:
WITH active_members AS (
    SELECT
        users.uuid,
        users.username,
        users.fullname,
        users.domaine,
        users.primary_email,
        matrix_accounts.matrix_id,
        startups.ghid
    FROM users
    JOIN missions AS active_mission
        ON  active_mission.user_id = users.uuid
        AND (active_mission.end >= NOW() OR active_mission.end IS NULL)
    LEFT JOIN missions_startups   ON missions_startups.mission_id = active_mission.uuid
    LEFT JOIN startups            ON startups.uuid = missions_startups.startup_id
    JOIN matrix_accounts          ON matrix_accounts.user_id = users.uuid
    WHERE
        users.primary_email_status = 'EMAIL_ACTIVE'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    username,
    matrix_id,
    domaine,
    primary_email,
    ghid
FROM active_members
ORDER BY username;
